title: Project Settings
description: Edit project metadata, generation defaults, coherence rules, and publication preferences.

navigation.title: Quick navigation
navigation.meta: Jump directly to the section you need

generation.title: Generation defaults
generation.meta: Fallback values used when a flow does not specify them
generation.helper: These preferences act as the base for new generation jobs and can still be overridden when launching a job.

preview.title: Manga preview
preview.helper: These options shape the reading and review interface for generated boards.

coherence.title: Coherence rules
coherence.meta: Controls what the warning scanner reports
coherence.helper: These rules are non-blocking: they do not stop writing, they only change what the scanner reports.

preview.title: Location preview
preview.description: The list below mirrors the allowed locations used by the scanner.
preview.empty: No allowed locations are defined yet.

signals.title: Narrative signals
signals.meta: Timeline anchors, tone tags, continuity facts, and impossible fact traps
signals.helper: Use the tokens @timeline:slug, @continuity:key=value, @tone:tag, and @fact:key=value inside scenes.

autoScan.label: Auto-scan on save
autoScan.description: Automatically re-run the coherence scanner after scene, character, relation, and settings saves.

versioning.title: Versioning
versioning.meta: How many versions to retain per branch
versioning.helper: The oldest versions are pruned automatically when the limit is exceeded.

exports.title: Exports
exports.meta: Default formats enabled for new publications
exports.helper: The format set below is used as the starting point when creating an export.

json.label: JSON
json.description: Structured project data for integration or archival.

tree.label: Tree
tree.description: Readable hierarchical view of project folders and contents.

zip.label: ZIP
zip.description: Compressed archive of the full project for transport and backup.

paged_images.label: Paged images
paged_images.description: Ordered image folders for reading and review.

pdf.label: PDF
pdf.description: Shareable reading document with preserved pagination.

cbz.label: CBZ
cbz.description: Image archive compatible with comic readers.

epub.label: EPUB
epub.description: E-reader format prepared for future distribution.

language.title: Language
language.helper: This language can serve as the default for the interface and project-scoped content.

assets.title: Assets
assets.helper: These options adjust how deletes and media-related guidance are presented.

archiveOnDelete.label: Archive on delete
archiveOnDelete.description: Keep a local trace of deleted assets instead of hard-deleting the file.

showUsageHints.label: Show usage hints
showUsageHints.description: Display contextual guidance for assets and reuse.

language.title: Language
language.description: Preference used as the default for project reading and editing

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: The auto-scan mode mirrors the manual warnings scan after supported writes.

unsavedChanges.label: Changed
unsavedChanges.summary: The changes will be written into the project's local JSON.
unsavedChanges.savedHint: The settings are synced with local storage.
unsavedChanges.confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?

orphanCharacter.label: Orphan characters
orphanCharacter.description: Flags active characters that are not linked to any scene or relation.

brokenReference.label: Broken references
brokenReference.description: Flags @ references that point to a missing entity.

emptyScene.label: Empty scenes
emptyScene.description: Warns when an active scene still has very little content.

locationConflict.label: Location conflicts
locationConflict.description: Detects scenes that use a location missing from the allowed list.

timelineConflict.label: Timeline conflicts
timelineConflict.description: Flags scenes whose timeline token does not match the registry order.

continuityBreak.label: Continuity breaks
continuityBreak.description: Flags scene assertions that disagree with the canonical continuity registry.

toneBreak.label: Tone breaks
toneBreak.description: Flags scenes that miss required tone tags or include forbidden ones.

impossibleFact.label: Impossible facts
impossibleFact.description: Flags scene facts that are explicitly forbidden by the project registry.

delete.sectionDescription: Once deleted, this project and all associated data (characters, scenes, assets) cannot be recovered.
delete.dialogDescription: This action is irreversible. To confirm, please type the project name below:
delete.errorNameMismatch: The entered name does not match the project name
